282926764.description: This hand-carved wooden wall plaque features a detailed bust of a man with a mustache, wearing a green hat and smoking a pipe. The carving showcases realistic facial features and textured clothing. The back is inscribed with '8. IV Wandertage Ober-Hainbrunn 1941,' indicating it was created as a commemorative piece for an event in Ober-Hainbrunn, Germany. The plaque includes a hole for wall mounting and exhibits vintage condition with signs of age.

283085267.description:
Vintage Novelty & Accessory Lot - 3 Carded Packages
Target / Dayton Hudson Corp, Retro Collectibles
Circa 1980s-1990s
A nostalgic assortment of deadstock vintage carded items from the 1980s to 1990s era, featuring two Target-distributed personal styling accessory sets and one carded sports novelty ballpoint pen set. These blister-carded products represent everyday retail novelties of the late 20th century, retaining their original retail packaging and pricing.
Items Included:
Target 7-Piece Accessory Set - Teal plastic headband, 2 hair combs, 2 cascade clips, and 2 ponyholders on original grid card
Target 7-Piece Accessory Set - Purple plastic headband, 2 hair combs, 2 cascade clips, and 2 ponyholders on original grid card
4 Sports Ball Pens Set - Carded novelty ballpoint pens shaped as a hockey stick, baseball bat, tennis racket, and golf club
Condition:
All three items remain factory sealed on their original blister cards. Cardboard backings display edge wear, corner curling, and creasing from storage. Clear plastic blister bubbles are intact with light surface scuffing. Novelty pens are vintage and untested; due to age, ink may be dried out.
